findings.summary: Conformance failure paths do not require unconditional cleanup of returned secret buffers.
findings.evidence: docs/issues/60/design.md:31-35 clears only successfully returned buffers after assertion. A broken source being tested can return a non-nil plaintext buffer together with an error, and an assertion can terminate the subtest before a subsequent clear. Neither case is named by the output-ownership tests, despite docs/issues/50/contracts.md:21-24 requiring caller-owned plaintext to be cleared on every exit and #60 S2 inheriting that rule.
findings.fix: Require Run and its fixtures to arrange deferred cleanup immediately for every non-nil plaintext/key buffer, before checking errors or making assertions, including buffers received with errors or late cancellation results. Add a deliberately violating source and a controlled failing assertion/cancellation path that prove the harness clears those buffers without printing their contents.
